title: doctool --gdscript-docs is missing enum descriptions
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in all of the following versions:
* v4.5.dev.custom_build [60aae6d85]
* v4.4.1.stable.custom_build [49a5bc7b6]
* v4.3.1.rc.custom_build [6699ae789]


### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (60aae6d85) - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 29 Mar 2025 06:09:17 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

When generating XML files from GDScript documentation comments, enum descriptions are missing from the resulting file, although they do appear properly in the editor documentation.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/205f2106-142f-45ee-bcc9-fa8f029e3be3)
```xml
[...]
	<constants>
		<constant name="FIRST_VALUE" value="0" enum="Test">
			First value
		</constant>
		<constant name="SECOND_VALUE" value="1" enum="Test">
			Second value
		</constant>
		<constant name="MY_CONST" value="0">
			Test constant
		</constant>
	</constants>
[...]
```

### Steps to reproduce

Add an enum to a class, add a documentation comment to it, then generate XML files:
```gdscript
## Test enumeration
enum Test {
    FIRST_VALUE,  # First value
    SECOND_VALUE,  # Second value
}
```
```sh
godot --doctool --gdscript-docs res://
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[doctool-gdscript-enum.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19972292/doctool-gdscript-enum.zip)

Execute `export_xml.sh` or `godot --doctool --gdscript-docs res://`.
